help.contract: Sum of contract values for delivery work, in each project currency. Left after spending uses complete recorded actuals. Source: dashboard summary. A currency whose source value is unavailable is shown as —.
help.margin: Known margin is billed-work revenue less recorded spending. It is not cash received. The margin amount is available, while the percentage is unavailable until billed revenue is available company-wide. A currency whose source value is unavailable is shown as —.
help.pipeline: Weighted pipeline is project value multiplied by stage win probability across open opportunities. The forecast margin is shown when the source can compute it. Missing comparable currency values are shown as —.
help.clientOverdue: Count of submitted or unpaid client invoices whose recorded due date has passed. The age is the oldest overdue invoice; amounts include only known balances.
help.supplierPayables: Sum of procurement records in the supplier-invoiced state awaiting payment. Unknown balances are omitted and counted below the amount.
help.unbilled: Remaining amount and count from open work orders that are not fully invoiced. If any work order could not be totaled, the note shows how many.
help.period: Period result from the selected date range.
help.invoiced: Sum of invoices issued within the selected period, excluding tax. Source: management pack by currency.
help.collected: Sum of recorded incoming payments received within the selected period. A currency with an unknown receipt amount shows —. Source: incoming payment records.
help.won: Count and value of projects recorded as won within the selected period.
help.winRate: Won projects divided by won plus lost projects in the selected period. The chart can switch between count and value.
help.stageMargin: Stage values and counts come from the sales pipeline. Stage-level forecast margin is not returned by the current read model.
help.pipelineStages: Stage counts and gross values come from the sales pipeline. Gross is grouped by project currency. The source does not return forecast margin by stage.
help.purchasesScope: Purchases made directly in the accounting system are not counted in this PMO procurement view.
